parsed.notes:
Anforderungen sets a required default; idealerweise makes AWS, AWS Glue and Lake Formation optional. Data Engineering is required, but these three unmapped skills have no taxonomy entries.
Alternative programming languages and concrete tool examples are each labeled separately.
Fundierte Erfahrung does not explicitly state proven experience, years or a level, so seniority is null.
Bewertung und Qualitätssicherung KI-generierter Ergebnisse is mapped to evaluation; it does not independently ask for software testing.
Technologies and practices appearing only under Aufgaben are excluded.
